title: Relationships
focus: 约会 · 分手 · 和好 · 谈恋爱 · 聚会 · 保持联系 · 面子 · 情商
body:
Dating, breaking up, making up, and the social skill that keeps it all smooth. Sentences reuse the feelings from L7, the people words from L8 and the job words from L16.

| Chinese | Pinyin | Meaning | Why |
|---|---|---|---|
| 约会 | yuēhuì | to go on a date / a date (romantic) | arranged meeting → a date |
| 分手 | fēnshǒu | to break up (a couple) | let go of hands |
| 和好 | héhǎo | to make up (after a fight) | back to harmony |
| 谈恋爱 | tán liàn'ài | to be in a romantic relationship | 'talk love' → be together |
| 聚会 | jùhuì | party / get-together | gather + meet → get-together |
| 保持联系 | bǎochí liánxì | to keep in touch | keep up + contact |
| 面子 | miànzi | face / dignity (social standing) | face → public dignity |
| 情商 | qíngshāng | emotional intelligence (EQ) | emotion quotient → EQ |

## Which word?

**约会 vs 谈恋爱:** 约会 is going on dates, which can be casual; 谈恋爱 means you are actually a couple. Both 谈恋爱 and 分手 are separable: 谈了五年恋爱, 分了手.

## Sentences

- 他们谈了五年恋爱，最后还是分手了。 tāmen tán le wǔ nián liàn'ài, zuìhòu háishi fēnshǒu le: They were in a relationship for five years and still broke up in the end.
- 他们闹了点矛盾，不过已经和好了。 tāmen nào le diǎn máodùn, búguò yǐjīng héhǎo le: They had a bit of a falling-out, but they've already made up.
- 他情商很高，懂得给领导留面子。 tā qíngshāng hěn gāo, dǒngde gěi lǐngdǎo liú miànzi: He has high EQ and knows how to let the boss save face.
- 他辞职以后，我们还一直保持联系。 tā cízhí yǐhòu, wǒmen hái yìzhí bǎochí liánxì: We've kept in touch ever since he quit.
- 部门聚会你都不去，有点不给面子。 bùmén jùhuì nǐ dōu bú qù, yǒudiǎn bù gěi miànzi: Skipping even the department get-together is a bit of a snub.
- 第一次约会就迟到，太尴尬了。 dì-yī cì yuēhuì jiù chídào, tài gāngà le: Being late for a first date is so awkward.
- 我怀疑他们在偷偷谈恋爱。 wǒ huáiyí tāmen zài tōutōu tán liàn'ài: I suspect they're secretly in a relationship.
- 分手了还保持联系，说明他们情商高。 fēnshǒu le hái bǎochí liánxì, shuōmíng tāmen qíngshāng gāo: Staying in touch after breaking up shows they both have high EQ.

cards.English: to go on a date / a date (romantic)
cards.Example: 他们俩最近在约会。 tāmen liǎ zuìjìn zài yuēhuì: Those two have been dating lately
cards.Notes: 约 yuē arrange, make an appointment (约好, 预约) + 会 huì meet (聚会, 见面) = an arranged meeting. 谈恋爱 = to be in a committed relationship; 约会 can be just going out.

cards.Example: 他们上个月分手了。 tāmen shàng ge yuè fēnshǒu le: They broke up last month
cards.Notes: 分 fēn separate (分开, 分别) + 手 shǒu hand = let go of each other's hands. Separable: 分了手. 离婚 = divorce (离 leave + 婚 marriage, 结婚).

cards.Example: 他们吵完架第二天就和好了。 tāmen chǎo wán jià dì-èr tiān jiù héhǎo le: They made up the day after their fight
cards.Notes: 和 hé harmony, peace (和平, 和气) + 好 hǎo good = back on good terms. 和好如初 = back to how things were. Shares 和 with 伤和气.

cards.English: to be in a romantic relationship
cards.Example: 他们谈恋爱谈了三年才结婚。 tāmen tán liàn'ài tán le sān nián cái jiéhūn: They dated for three years before getting married
cards.Notes: 谈 tán talk, 讠 speech (谈话, 谈判) + 恋爱 liàn'ài romantic love (恋 love, 心 heart, 失恋 heartbreak + 爱 love) = to 'talk love': be in a relationship. Separable: 谈了三年恋爱 = 谈恋爱谈了三年.

cards.Example: 周末有个同学聚会。 zhōumò yǒu ge tóngxué jùhuì: There's a class reunion this weekend
cards.Notes: 聚 jù gather (团聚, 聚在一起) + 会 huì meet (会议, 约会) = a gathering. 派对 is a sound loan of 'party' for a Western-style party; 聚会 covers any gathering.

cards.Example: 毕业以后我们一直保持联系。 bìyè yǐhòu wǒmen yìzhí bǎochí liánxì: We've kept in touch since graduation
cards.Notes: 保持 = 保 protect (保护) + 持 hold, 扌 hand (支持) = keep up; 联系 = 联 connect + 系 tie (关系) = contact. So: keep the ties connected. Common sign-off: 以后保持联系！

cards.Example: 当着大家的面批评他，太不给他面子了。 dāngzhe dàjiā de miàn pīpíng tā, tài bù gěi tā miànzi le: Criticizing him in front of everyone made him lose face
cards.Notes: 面 miàn face (见面, 面前) + 子 zi noun suffix (桌子) = face, one's public image. 给面子 give face, 丢面子 lose face, 爱面子 be image-conscious. 当着大家的面 = in front of everyone.

cards.Example: 他情商很高，跟谁都处得来。 tā qíngshāng hěn gāo, gēn shéi dōu chǔ de lái: He has high EQ, he gets along with everyone
cards.Notes: 情 qíng emotion, 忄 heart (感情) + 商 shāng, usually trade (商店) but in math 'quotient', the result of division = emotional quotient, modeled on 智商 IQ (智 wisdom, 智能).

cards.English: They were in a relationship for five years and still broke up in the end.
cards.Hanzi: 他们谈了五年恋爱，最后还是分手了。
cards.Pinyin: tāmen tán le wǔ nián liàn'ài, zuìhòu háishi fēnshǒu le.
cards.Notes: 谈恋爱 (L19) + 分手 (L19). 谈恋爱 splits: 谈了五年恋爱.

cards.English: They had a bit of a falling-out, but they've already made up.
cards.Hanzi: 他们闹了点矛盾，不过已经和好了。
cards.Pinyin: tāmen nào le diǎn máodùn, búguò yǐjīng héhǎo le.
cards.Notes: 和好 (L19) + 矛盾 (L8). 闹矛盾 = fall out.

cards.English: He has high EQ and knows how to let the boss save face.
cards.Hanzi: 他情商很高，懂得给领导留面子。
cards.Pinyin: tā qíngshāng hěn gāo, dǒngde gěi lǐngdǎo liú miànzi.
cards.Notes: 情商 (L19) + 面子 (L19) + 领导 (L6). 给…留面子 = let someone save face.

cards.English: We've kept in touch ever since he quit.
cards.Hanzi: 他辞职以后，我们还一直保持联系。
cards.Pinyin: tā cízhí yǐhòu, wǒmen hái yìzhí bǎochí liánxì.

cards.English: Skipping even the department get-together is a bit of a snub.
cards.Hanzi: 部门聚会你都不去，有点不给面子。
cards.Pinyin: bùmén jùhuì nǐ dōu bú qù, yǒudiǎn bù gěi miànzi.
cards.Notes: 聚会 (L19) + 面子 (L19) + 部门 (L16). 不给面子 = snub someone.

cards.English: Being late for a first date is so awkward.
cards.Hanzi: 第一次约会就迟到，太尴尬了。
cards.Pinyin: dì-yī cì yuēhuì jiù chídào, tài gāngà le.

cards.English: I suspect they're secretly in a relationship.
cards.Hanzi: 我怀疑他们在偷偷谈恋爱。
cards.Pinyin: wǒ huáiyí tāmen zài tōutōu tán liàn'ài.
cards.Notes: 谈恋爱 (L19) + 怀疑 (L17). 偷偷 = secretly.

cards.English: Staying in touch after breaking up shows they both have high EQ.
cards.Hanzi: 分手了还保持联系，说明他们情商高。
cards.Pinyin: fēnshǒu le hái bǎochí liánxì, shuōmíng tāmen qíngshāng gāo.
cards.Notes: 分手 (L19) + 保持联系 (L19) + 情商 (L19). 说明 = shows, goes to show.
